balls.text: "how do you spell comedy?" Richie Benaud would have said! Vinay tries to flick the yorker from outside leg, misses and they take a bye. But that's not it. Dhoni throws the ball and Bravo doesn't collect it halfway through the pitch and the ball is rolling towards mid on, they take the second run and Mohit runs in to collide with Bravo. Mohit gets hit on his chest, but they look fine after some time

that's two in two, full toss gets a wicket now! Attempted yorker is a full toss on the pads, Pollard flicks it in the air and deep backward square leg takes a straightforward catch. Dwayne Smith the fielder
slower ball brings the fall of Rayudu! He picked the ball from around off, it was fullish, to the leg side and Jadeja took a simple catch around his left shoulder at deep midwicket
almost in the block hole on middle, driven down to long on for one
full toss on the pads, he doesn't need to use much power on that and merely flicks it off the legs, wide of short fine leg to help it for four
paddle sweeps the full and slow delivery from way outside off to the leg side to give strike to Pollard
tries another unorthodox shot - goes down on a knee well before the ball is delivered, it's slow towards middle and he steers it towards short third man for one
that's a full toss around waist height and that's six! You would imagine such a ball around off stump to be pulled to the leg side but he pulled it straight down the ground to wards the sight screen
swing and a miss! It's on length outside off, Rayudu goes for an extravagant drive and misses
slower ball at 105kph on middle, it's too short and Rayudu makes room to hammer it over the deep midwicket fielder for six
attempted yorker is a full toss around off, Pollard sends it down to long on for one
slower delivery on length outside off, Rayudu defends with a forward lean and gives strike to Pollard
in the block hole outside off, Pollard swings hard and misses
slightly slow and back of length on leg, Rayudu pulls and gets one to long on
right in the block hole, inside edge goes to short fine leg for one
just misses the off stump as Pollard heaves at the slower ball and misses
Faf can do anything on the field! Pollard flicked the low full toss from outside leg, by making room, to the cow corner, Faf ran to his right from long on and nearly flew to flick the back inside
back of length outside leg, tries to steer it to leg and the ball lobs off bat and pad for one
fullish towards the pads, he flicks it late off the legs fine down the leg side and gets four more
has enough time for it and whips the short of length ball off the back foot to leg for two. That's his fifty off 21 balls
slightly slower and shorter outside off, heaves it down to long on for one
shuffles across towards off, Pandey sends it just down leg past the leg stump
middles this time - six! Charged down the ground for the short ball and tonked it to the cow corner boundary for maximum
throws his bat at the delivery outside off, gets a thick outside edge an it goes fine on the off side for a lucky four
back of length on middle stump, Rayudu cuts it off the back foot for a quick single
full on middle and off, pushed down easily with a straight bat to mid off for one
nearly in the block hole now, flicked towards wide long on in the gap for two
on length but outside leg, clipped off the pads towards square leg for one
he drives the length delivery down from off, Bravo gets both hands to it
back of length from outside leg, tucked off the pads for one
fifty and out! Slower through the air and angled in, Rohit slams it down the ground and finds Bravo at long on for an easy catch
too full outside off and another exquisite drive from Rohit through the covers and he gets to his fifty
makes room for the slower ball outside leg, Nehra's ball chases him as Pollard slogs and gets a single past midiwcket
shortish towards the batsman, pulled to deep midwicket for two
full outside off, chipped down to long off for an easy single
back of length outside off, square-driven off the back foot to deep point for two
and another one, the belligerent Pollard is clearing the boundary at will. On length outside off and he hammers it over the long on boundary with some power
low full toss on middle and leg, straight drive and he beats long on and long off both
just a bit too short, Pollard rocks back and slams the ball from well outside off between long and deep midwicket for six more!
bit of room outside off, pushed down to long on now for one more
low full toss on middle and leg, driven down to long on for one
too full and wide outside off, called wide
flat and wide outside off, Pollard throws his arms at it and tonks it straight down over long off for a clean six

that's a stumping chance, Dhoni has flicked the bails in no time, as usual. Pollard came down, Jadeja pitched it wide outside off, Pollard missed the ball while swinging his arms, Dhoni didn't miss but it looks like Pollard dragged his right foot back just in time to get in
the slower ball is too full outside off and Rohit drives it with great timing to pierce the gap in the covers for four
fuller towards the pads, flicked along the ground to the leg side for one
too short, too big and that's six! Pollar went back quickly for the short ball around off and pulled it just in time to midwicket boundary for six!
slow offcutter well outside off, cut off the back foot for one
full delivery angled in towards middle and leg, driven down the ground and Mohit stops it at long on
firm drive off the full toss into the covers, Baz throws himself to his left and saves a few runs
slow again with some flight outside off, Pollard leans forward and blocks
slower through the air as Pollard comes down, slogs, doesn't middle it but gets enough to beat deep midwicket for a four
flat and straight outside off, pushed to cover
flighted outside of, Rohit leans forward and pushes it square of the wicket for one
shorter and wider outside off, Rohit goes back to let it turn and cuts it past point in the gap for two as Nehra kicks the ball inside
welcomes him with a six! Rohit dances down the ground for the ball outside off to take it on the full and lofts it over the long off boundary for a six
on length around off, turned against the spin to midwicket
takes a step down and steers the ball from off to long on for one
bit of room outside off, pushed into the covers for one
on length around off, blocked back this time
that's gone out of this planet! Jadeja pitched it up on the stumps, and Pollard lofted it straight down the ground, very very high and it went a long way into the stands over the press box
fullish on middle and leg, flicked to the leg side for one
full on off, driven down the ground just past Mohit and they take a quick single by the time mid off gets to it
offcutter comes in towards off stump, Rohit defends it back
caresses it through the covers! It was full around off, right in Rohit's zone and he drove it through the covers effortlessly, all along the ground for four

finally he falls, finally the ball finds a fielder! Short of length ball towards the stumps, Harbhajan cleared his front foot and threw his bat at it, got a leading edge and Jadeja ran a few steps to his right from fly slip for an easy catch
cracking four! He made room early, saw the ball outside off and pierced the gap between point and deep cover for four
back of length outside off and swinging away, Harbhajan swings and misses
towards the pads now and he tucks it behind square on leg for one
dropped! Darts it outside off, Bhajji got an outside edge while cutting the ball and Dhoni couldn't hold on to it
room outside off for the length delivery, driven to sweeper cover for one
flighted on leg as Bhajji shuffles across, guides to midwicket for one
shorter and wider, cut to cover point
that's gone all the way! Jadeja pitched it up a little, Harbhajan nearly went down on a knee and slog-swept it over long on for six
superb slower delivery on the stumps. The batsman was looking to swing it across the line but adjusts well to push it to off for a single.
comes forward and punches the length ball on the up to deep cover

could have been tight at the non-striker's end! The bowler almost bowls a legspinner and Harbhajan taps it to point. Slight hesitation there for a single, but Jadeja doesn't take it cleanly, allowing them to get through
gets a bouncer this time. Harbhajan looks to pull it first, then withdraws from the short seeing it rising awkwardly
floats it up on off stump, Rohit comes forward and punches it down to long on. Not really off the middle but that is an easy single
gets width and Rohit does well, comes forward and slashes it through backward point. No chance for third man there
length delivery just outside off, mistimes it to cover
touch flatter and shorter outside off, Bhajji cuts and misses
too full and straight, Bhajji slams it straight down the ground, slightly in the air for a powerful four
room outside off with some turn, he drives it straight to cover
angled in towards middle stump now, steered down to mid on for an easy single
pretty flat on off, pushed to cover without much movement
slower ball to end the over, it cuts away from outside off and beats Harbhajan
three in a row! This time he pulls the short ball to the leg side, gets a top edge and the ball falls right in between deep square leg and midwicket
he throws his bat at it again and escapes again! Slogs the back of length ball from outside off, this time the ball goes square on the off side and clears cover point
high in the air, but he gets some distance too and just clears mid off! Heaved on the off side, got a leading edge and Faf ran back a long way. If he could not get to it, nobody would have
chipped in the air off the back foot, but it falls safe in the wide gap between mid off and cover for one
bit too short and Rohit gets on top of that - pulled away to the midwicket boundary for four!
on middle and leg, steered off the pads just wide of midwicket for a single
no room again. Good-length ball on off with the angle, pushed into the covers
angling away from around off stump, Rohit stays back and defends it into the covers
on length and on off stump, Rohit defends it back now
slashes and cuts it over point for four! Looks like a man in form there - it was wide, it was short and Rohit found that enough to clear point to collect a four
on the pads from over the wicket, tucked away to deep square leg for one
pokes outside off as the ball swings away, misses it completely as the ball had some bounce too
length delivery on off stump, no room at all for Harbhajan and he defends it back
outswinger well outside off doesn't bounce much and is called a wide

and Simmons is gone too, another catch down the ground for Faf! Made some room, maybe Pandey anticipated it and pitched outside off, Simmons swung his arms wildly, didn't middle it and found du Plessis for a simple catch at the edge of the circle
shuffles across completely to expose his stumps, guides the ball to wide second slip
throws his bat at this one too outside off, can't clear mid off
off the middle of the bat, just wide of cover point! He made room early, the ball was just outside off and Simmons slashed it right in between cover point and point for a cracking four
angling across Rohit outside off, he simply guides it to third man by opening the face of the bat

how does Faf always take such catches?! Third ball in a row Anderson did not middle, he pulled the back of length ball down the ground, got a leading edge right over the bowler's head and du Plessis ran from mid off to his left to dive backwards and catch it as if that's what he does every morning after waking up
doesn't get the middle again - bit back of length around off, Anderson slaps it back in the air past Nehra but falls well short of mid off
thick edge goes for four past the slips! He came down the ground again with some room, swung his arms for the outswinger and got a thick edge to the third man boundary
right on target now, length fullish delivery on the middle stump and Anderson blocks it back
charges down, smashes the ball down the ground and Faf dives to his left to stop the ball at mid off. Saved four for sure
outswing to end the over too, back of length outside off, Simmons goes back and drives it into the covers
slightly short of length outside off with some outswing, pushed to point
straight to McCullum this time as Simmons punches the ball from outside off again, not in the gap though
what an effort from Baz! Simmons punched the short of length ball off the back foot between point and cover point and Baz threw himself to his left to snatch it
late outswing now and further outside off stump, Simmons shoulders arms this time
beaten straightaway! Pandey swings the ball away a touch from outside the off stump, Simmons poked and withdrew his bat but a bit too late
bit of swing again outside off, Anderson watches and lets it go again
nice outswing from Nehra outside off. It was well outside off actually and moving away and Anderson let it go
way down the leg side this time for a wide

golden duck for PP, Nehra has struck in the first over! This one was swinging in from leg stump, Parthiv looked to glance it off the pads but could not connect and was struck in front of leg. Finger went up in no time even though it wasn't really plumb
pushes the inswinging length delivery towards cover and sets off for a quick single
on off stump now with some inswing, Simmons defends it back
length delivery outside off, with the angle, left alone
he seals it with a six at Wankhede, similar shot to Dhoni's! Pitched up and he launched it to the wide long-on boundary for maximum, CSK romp home
smartly played, that levels the scores! It was shortish outside off and coming in, Bravo waited and then helped it fine on the off side to beat third man for four
straight to cover and dropped by Harbhajan! Raina came down and drove the ball to cover at shoulder height, Bhajji got both hands to it but put it down
you can't bowl there at that pace to an in-form Raina - short on leg, he swivels the ball wide of long on for four
that's well outside the off stump on length, called a wide
short again, Raina eyes the gap between deep midwicket and fine leg, pulls the ball but Malinga kicks it inside running to his right from fine leg
back of length on leg stump, steered to fine leg easily for one
classical defence from Bravo as he goes back in the crease for the short ball around off
back of length towards leg stump, Raina pulls it to deep midwicket
bouncer angled down leg, he pulls and misses

lands safe after being in the air for very long! It was on length from Suyal, Raina whipped on the leg side and a leading edge went to the off side to fall between cover and deep cover. Run out chance also missed
angled into the batsman, Bravo tucks the ball wide of fine leg in the gap for two

he's taken a wicket, he's got the consolatory wicket of Dhoni! Slower offcutter from outside off, Dhoni marched down the ground and slapped the ball back to the bowler, who took it around waist height with both hands
fullish around off, lofted down the ground to long off
this slower ball is too full, Raina puts his front foot forward and executes a beautiful straight drive down the ground for a one-bounce four
bouncer outside off now, Raina leaves again and this is a no ball for height
short ball down the leg side for a wide. Raina watches it go to the keeper
slow again, and on length outside off, Raina defends it
slow and full well outside off, driven through the covers for one
touch back of length towards middle and leg, Dhoni turns on the back foot to help it to fine leg
short of length ball coming in, Raina helps it late to third man
crackalicious! Vinay sends in a bouncer, and as if Raina was expecting it, he pulled it with such disdain from the middle of his bat to the cow corner
slower ball on length outside off, Raina defends it with soft hands close to himself with an edge
angles the back short of length ball in, Raina defends off the back foot
short of length on the leg stump, Raina shuffles across and swivels it behind square on the leg side to beat fine leg for four
back of length delivery outside off to end the over, Dhoni slices it to point
attempts the yorker that got Faf, it's a low full toss this time and Dhoni pushes it down to mid off
Raina gets a bouncer on middle and leg and pulls it comfortably behind square on leg
full outside off and Dhoni uses his wrists to drive it to deep point, off the mark first ball

how do you bowl that, and how do you play that? Yorked on middle stump! pretty straightforward that one - straight on middle stump, as accurate as it could be on middle stump, and Faf's bat came down late to block it
widish outside off and he guides it late to third man for one
slightly more flight on middle and leg, pushed down to long on for one
this one comes in from well outside off, Raina knows third man is in and cuts it late enough to collect four
targets the off stump this time with a length delivery, Raina pushes it back
touch flat outside off, Raina goes back to cut and misses
dances down the track, takes it on the full, lofts it down the ground, long-on only watches and that goes all the way!
pretty flat and wide outside off, left alone
fullish slow ball outside off and it's pushed into the covers
another slower ball - on length outside off and this one beats Faf
accurate slow yorker just outside off, Faf blocks it on the off side
bouncer around off now - pulled a bit wide of deep midwicket in the gap for two
bouncer down the leg side from Malinga, easily called a wide
short of length outside off, pushed down the ground to long off
back of length on middle and leg, tucked wide of midwicket for one
flighted well outside off, Faf mistimes the drive to cover
fullish on off and Faf paddles it fine down the leg side with the turn. He knew fine leg was squarish and executed it well to beat that fielder
flight this time on off stump, Raina comes back and turns it to leg for one
flattish outside off, cuts it straight to point
turning in with some flight, driven down to long on for one
flights it outside leg as Raina comes down to drive it to long on for one
gives the charge and hammers the fullish ball from off stump down the ground and over mid off for four. He doesn't feel the pressure
Parthiv appeals, Vinay doesn't move after bowling a snorting outswinger outside off. Faf poked without much footwork and nearly edged it behind
doesn't bounce as much as Faf chases the ball outside off on the back foot and misses
moves towards off and pushes the length delivery to cover
shuffles across and tucks the ball from around off behind square on leg for one
back of length offcutter towards off stump, Faf defends it to cover

another mistimed shot, another wicket for Harbhajan in the over! this was flat and well outside off, Smith slog-swept it to the leg side, got a top edge very high and Rohit took the catch going back a few steps from midwicket
quicker and turning towards the pads, he sweeps and takes it on the pads
slightly slower outside off, pushed into the covers
slog-swept with the turn for six! Doesn't matter if a wicket has fallen, Smith nearly goes down on a knee and hits it just over deep backward's head for six
straight down long-off's throat! Baz came down the track to take it on the full, did not succeed, and mistimed that one down to Vinay Kumar for an easy one
turning in from length just outside off, reverse swept fine on off for two in the gap
short ball is pulled down to long on for one
low full toss wide outside off again, called wide again
full and wide way outside the off stump, Baz lets it go
how does he do that?! Baz shuffles across and ramps the short ball from just outside off fine on the leg side for six. That's gone all the way! 100 up in the seventh over
back of length just outside off, slices it late to third man for one
full toss, Smith clears his front foot and smashes it to the midwicket boundary for a one-bounce four wide of deep midwicket
full on the stumps, driven down to long off and it's a no ball for overstepping
in the block hole on off stump, thick edge goes down to third man
bouncer angled across well outside off, Smith chases with enthusiasm but misses
nudged towards the gap at midwicket and Smith has his fifty. CSK at 90 for 0, Second-highest score in the powerplay in IPL. CSK have the record as well, 100 v Kings XI last year
deft! It was a good length a shade outside off, Smith dabs at it with the open face and sends it scurrying to the third man boundary.
nip down the track to drill the fuller delivery down to long-on
tossed up on off stump, ran down the track and lofts it over cover. They don't seem to be interested in anything else and this pitch has the ball coming on very nicely

pierces the gap between cover and mid-off and it seems Rohit has damaged his shoulder badly! it was a bullet drive from Baz and it seemed destined for four. Rohit threw himself after the ball on the cusp of the boundary, much like Baz does, but he has landed awkwardly on his right shoulder. Seems to have shaken it off. Windmilling that hand now.
miscue, but he's beaten the offside infield. Held the ball back a touch, but he went through with the lofted drive and gets reward
fine leg was up and Smith has played a dinky little sweep past him! That's 72 runs in five overs! Flat and quick and sliding down. The batsman just had to give it direction
nudges it to square leg and Harbhajan gets to the ball quickly to prevent the single
tossed up, and that is enough for Smith to lean forward and lift it over extra cover. Pure power. Flat six
slips a flatter delivery down the leg side, and Smith's only concern would be getting that back foot to safety in case of the stumping and then collect the wide
and then there's the power! A tossed up delivery to make up for the previous ball and Smith plants his front leg down and hammers it over long-on
a hint of width and Smith moves across with his back foot to get close to it and employs the latest of late cuts. Makes contact almost as the ball was heading to the keeper's gloves
good length ball on middle, but the spinner's begun to dart the ball in, defended to mid-on on the edge of the circle and picks up a single
no one on the off side boundary and Smith clears that front leg and lashes a full toss on off stump to the extra cover boundary
banged in short on middle, Smith prefers to duck under it and looks up to watch the umpire signal a no-ball, and a free hit. Big one as well
another full toss and it's nudged straight of midwicket
offcutter, but it slips down leg. Smith takes a while to adjust to it and can't quite get the flick going
shortish and outside off, Smith plants an open face on it and directs it to deep third man. Rayudu is the man moving to his left, but he overruns it.. Sloppy
pace off the ball brings a miscue as McCullum looks for a smash through the covers, and ends up with an inside edge towards square leg
full toss on off stump, McCullum brings his bat down and punches it past the outstretched left hand of Malinga. There's not stopping it from there
pacy, short, not enough room to free the arms. But McCullum takes it on. Pushes his weight back and hammers a pull to the midwicket boundary
goes back and across to knock a good length ball towards the leg side. Suchith is on hand to stop it
shortish again, but this time Simmons runs around to his left and stops the cut at cover point
too much width this time and Smith crashes it through the covers. Benefits from the shorter length as he rocks back and hits the gap
seemed to hold it back a touch and made Smith reach out a little more. Wants to clatter it away again, but has to check his shot
tossed up outside off, Smith reaches out and lifts the ball clean into the stands behind long-on. Appeared like he hadn't timed it, but the ball sailed away
goes back to a good length ball and clips to the left of deep midwicket
hands on head for Lasith as the fuller delivery veers away from Smith's groping bat. It was full and it pulled the batsman into a defensive push, but the cut on the ball defeats him
presents a full toss, just about below the hips, as McCullum taps it to mid-on and gets across to the other end
overpitched, and McCullum flays the ball over cover! Plants that front leg forward, but down the pitch to make sure he has enough room to lash it one-bounce to the fence
sneaks in the offcutter this time and it's a little wide. McCullum is a little off put by the lack of speed on the ball and chops it into the covers
top-edge, sails into the stands! Malinga's pace does a lot of work again as McCullum swivels on a pull, is not quite quick enough on it and yet benefits
banged in and this certainly had pace. A bit too much judging from how the ball leaps high over McCullum's head as he leaves outside off
looks to hit his comfort zone straight away as he bowls at McCullum's toes. Seemed a touch slower though, as the batsman adjusts and blocks
picked up and deposited to the square leg boundary. Strays in length and at his pace he can't be short. Moves back and across and whacks it
back of a length and outside off, Smith pushes to mid-off as well
top lines form Suyal as he hits off stump on a good length and keeps McCullum honest. Knocks it down to mid-off

that's a top delivery, and McCullum has done just as well to get his partner to safety at the other end. Full and swinging in on middle and off stump. Smith was looking to hack it through midwicket and gets an inside edge that wanders away behind point. McCullum had seen the opportunity for a single and dragged his partner along
width on offer and Smith cracks it to cover point. Didn't concentrate on his timing as much as caning the ball
a little bit of swerve back in at the batsman, started on middle and leg though. Struck on the pads as he was trying to flick
